hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in *.py) uv run ruff check "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" ;; esac
hooks.description: Check edited Python files with Ruff

hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in src/crypto_threshold/*.py|src/crypto_threshold/**/*.py) test_file="tests/test_$(basename "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" .py).py"; if [ -f "$test_file" ]; then uv run pytest "$test_file" -q --tb=no; fi ;; esac
hooks.description: Run related tests when source files change
